schemes.title: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (SVMCM) for Higher Secondary & UG
schemes.department: Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal
schemes.description: Premier merit-cum-means scholarship for meritorious students of West Bengal scoring at least 60 percent in qualifying examinations.

schemes.title: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (SVMCM) for Postgraduate Studies
schemes.department: Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal
schemes.description: Financial assistance of ₹2,000 to ₹2,500 per month for university students pursuing M.A., M.Sc., M.Com and professional postgraduate programs in West Bengal.

schemes.title: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Kanyashree (K3) Enrolled Girls
schemes.department: Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal
schemes.description: Dedicated scholarship for female students registered under Kanyashree K2 who secure admission in regular PG courses across West Bengal.
